catalog: union of all official Amazon_Fashion parent_asin IDs; no tactile/image filter
split: existing hash-verified official 0core/last_out; no new split
test_history: train plus preceding official validation event; no parameter refit on validation
seen_filter: all previous parent_asin interactions, all methods
no_history_fallback: train popularity with stable parent_asin tie-break for every model
unknown_mf_user_fallback: train popularity; learned MF user IDs cannot encode an unseen user
untrained_id_item_embedding: zero for pure ID models; retain item in catalog with deterministic tie-break
backbone_selection: validation NDCG@10 descending, HR@10 descending, MRR@10 descending, fixed model order
candidate_rule: smallest K with validation recall >= 0.80; otherwise K=3000 and report retrieval bottleneck unresolved
missing_tactile: retain base normalized score unchanged (zero tactile adjustment)
history_profile: category-local mean only; no cross-category tactile preference transfer
alpha_selection: validation NDCG@10, smallest alpha on ties including zero
tactile_query_evaluation: old v3 family-heldout test only; select explicit alpha on old v3 development. Mask unknowns. Previously inspected test is exploratory, not new confirmatory evidence.
human_audit: skip unless real submitted human labels exist; never generate human answers
historical_average_interpretation: proxy, not proof of liking every attribute
